response.text:
I can’t forward private email threads without explicit confirmation. A few quick clarifications so I do exactly what you want:

- Which advisor (email address)? I can’t guess identities.
- Which thread exactly? (Give the thread subject, a snippet, or the date of the emails to forward.)
- Include attachments and original recipients/headers? (Yes / No)
- Add a message when forwarding? If so, what should it say?
- Confirm you authorize me to forward this thread to the specified external address.

If you prefer, I can draft the forwarding email now for you to review and send yourself. Which would you like?
